APPROVE
Moving the `Apply` branch (its nested ternary, early-exit `if` and lambda ternaries) into `RegisterApplier` cuts roughly 15–18 points, which should put `BuildPlan` well under 15; dropping the `var m = method` copies is safe because `method` is a fresh variable on each loop iteration in C# 5 and later; and the logic is otherwise identical — though I couldn't find the repo here, so I haven't confirmed the build, which depends on the file already having `using System.Reflection;` and `appliers` being exactly `Dictionary<Type, Func<object, object, object, object?>>`.
